items.headline: World Health Day 2022: 'Our planet, our health'
items.detail: World Health Day was observed on April 7, marking the founding of the World Health Organization. The First World Health Assembly in 1948 decided to observe the day each year, effective from 1950. The 2022 theme was 'Our planet, our health'.

items.headline: Elon Musk offers $43 billion to buy Twitter
items.detail: On April 14, 2022 Elon Musk made an unsolicited offer to buy Twitter for $43 billion, valuing it at $54.20 per share. Twitter's board unanimously accepted a $44 billion buyout on April 25, 2022; the deal closed in October 2022.

items.headline: Earth Day 2022: 'Invest in Our Planet'
items.detail: Earth Day was observed on April 22, the annual environment awareness day first held in 1970. The 2022 theme was 'Invest in Our Planet'.

items.headline: Macron re-elected French President
items.detail: Emmanuel Macron won France's presidential runoff on April 24, 2022 with 58.55% against Marine Le Pen's 41.45% - the first French president to win a re-election bid since Jacques Chirac in 2002.

items.headline: Gen Manoj Pande takes over as 29th Army Chief
items.detail: General Manoj Pande took over as India's 29th Chief of the Army Staff on April 30, 2022, succeeding General Manoj Mukund Naravane. An officer of the Corps of Engineers (Bombay Sappers), he is the first Army Chief from that corps.
examFacts: First chief from the Corps of Engineers

quiz.q: Elon Musk's April 2022 offer priced Twitter at what amount per share?
quiz.solution: The April 14, 2022 unsolicited offer valued Twitter at $54.20 per share, about $43 billion.

quiz.q: Twitter's board accepted a buyout of what value on April 25, 2022?
quiz.solution: The board unanimously accepted Elon Musk's $44 billion buyout offer; the deal closed in October 2022.

quiz.q: Emmanuel Macron's April 2022 re-election made him the first French president re-elected since:
quiz.solution: Macron beat Marine Le Pen 58.55%-41.45% - the first successful re-election bid since Chirac in 2002.

quiz.q: General Manoj Pande, who became Army Chief in April 2022, is the first chief from which corps?
quiz.solution: A Bombay Sappers officer, he is the first Army Chief from the Corps of Engineers.

quiz.q: General Manoj Pande succeeded whom as the 29th Chief of the Army Staff?
quiz.solution: He took over from General Manoj Mukund Naravane on April 30, 2022.

quiz.q: The 2022 theme of World Health Day (April 7) was:
quiz.solution: World Health Day 2022 carried the theme 'Our planet, our health'.

quiz.q: Earth Day, first held in 1970, is observed every year on:
quiz.solution: Earth Day has been observed on April 22 since the first one in 1970; the 2022 theme was 'Invest in Our Planet'.

items.headline: Santoor maestro Shivkumar Sharma passes away
items.detail: Pandit Shivkumar Sharma, the legendary santoor player who gave the instrument a place in Hindustani classical music, died on May 10, 2022 at the age of 84.

items.headline: India win maiden Thomas Cup title
items.detail: India won their first-ever Thomas Cup title on May 15, 2022, beating 14-time champions Indonesia 3-0 in the final at Bangkok, Thailand, where the tournament ran from May 8 to 15.

items.headline: PM Modi visits Lumbini on Buddha Purnima
items.detail: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Lumbini, Nepal - the birthplace of Gautam Buddha - on May 16, 2022 on the occasion of Buddha Purnima, and jointly laid the foundation stone of an Indian monastery with Nepali PM Sher Bahadur Deuba.

items.headline: Nikhat Zareen becomes world boxing champion
items.detail: Nikhat Zareen won gold in the women's 52 kg flyweight division at the IBA Women's World Boxing Championships in Istanbul (May 8-20, 2022). Manisha Moun and Parveen Hooda added bronze medals, taking India to fourth in the medal table with three medals.

items.headline: QUAD leaders meet at Tokyo summit
items.detail: The leaders of the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue (QUAD) - host Japanese PM Fumio Kishida, US President Joe Biden, Indian PM Narendra Modi and Australian PM Anthony Albanese - met at the QUAD leaders' summit in Tokyo on May 24, 2022.

items.headline: Gujarat Titans win IPL 2022 in debut season
items.detail: Gujarat Titans won their maiden IPL title in their first season, beating Rajasthan Royals by 7 wickets in the final at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad on May 29, 2022. Jos Buttler was the season's most valuable player with a tournament-high 863 runs.

items.headline: Playback singer KK dies at 54
items.detail: Popular playback singer Krishnakumar Kunnath, known as KK, died on May 31, 2022 at the age of 54 after performing at a concert in Kolkata.

quiz.q: India won its first-ever Thomas Cup title in May 2022 by defeating which team 3-0 in the final?
quiz.solution: India beat defending champions Indonesia 3-0 in the Bangkok final on May 15, 2022.

quiz.q: The 2022 Thomas & Uber Cup was hosted by which city?
quiz.solution: The tournament ran May 8-15, 2022 in Bangkok, Thailand.

quiz.q: Nikhat Zareen won the 2022 World Boxing Championships gold in which weight category?
quiz.solution: She won the 52 kg flyweight title at Istanbul; India finished with 1 gold and 2 bronze.

quiz.q: The 2022 QUAD leaders' summit of May 24 was hosted by:
quiz.solution: Japanese PM Fumio Kishida hosted Biden, Modi and Albanese in Tokyo.

quiz.q: Which team won the IPL 2022 title in its debut season?
quiz.solution: Gujarat Titans beat Rajasthan Royals by 7 wickets in the May 29, 2022 final at Ahmedabad.

quiz.q: The IPL 2022 final was played at which stadium?
quiz.solution: The final was held at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad on May 29, 2022.

quiz.q: Santoor maestro Pandit Shivkumar Sharma, who passed away in May 2022, was associated with which instrument?
quiz.solution: Shivkumar Sharma (1938-2022) made the santoor a classical Hindustani instrument.

quiz.q: PM Modi visited Lumbini, Nepal in May 2022 on the occasion of:
quiz.solution: He visited the Buddha's birthplace on Buddha Purnima, May 16, 2022.

items.headline: Assam floods submerge large tracts along the Brahmaputra
items.detail: The second wave of Assam's 2022 floods (June-September) forced the Brahmaputra and Barak rivers over their banks, affecting about 5.6 million people across 32 districts in one of the state's worst flood seasons in a decade; the season's death toll reached 197 and Silchar remained submerged for six days.

items.headline: World Environment Day 2022 hosted by Sweden
items.detail: World Environment Day was observed on June 5, 2022 with the theme 'Only One Earth', hosted by Sweden to mark 50 years since the 1972 Stockholm Conference that established the observance.

items.headline: Agnipath short-service recruitment scheme announced
items.detail: On June 14, 2022 the government announced the Agnipath scheme: soldiers recruited as 'Agniveers' serve a four-year tenure (six months training plus 3.5 years deployment) at ages 17.5-21, with up to 25% of each batch retained in the permanent cadre and the rest discharged with a lump sum of about Rs 11.71 lakh and no pension. Nationwide protests broke out on June 16, and the 2022 recruitment age limit was relaxed to 23.

items.headline: First private train under Bharat Gaurav scheme flagged
items.detail: India's first private train under the Bharat Gaurav scheme began running on Southern Railway from June 14, 2022, operating on a Coimbatore-Shirdi route.

items.headline: Opposition picks Yashwant Sinha for President
items.detail: Opposition parties named former union minister Yashwant Sinha as their candidate for the July 2022 presidential election on June 21, 2022, setting up a contest against NDA nominee Droupadi Murmu.

items.headline: International Day of Yoga observed on June 21
items.detail: The International Day of Yoga was observed on June 21 - proposed by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in his September 2014 UN address and adopted by the UN General Assembly on December 11, 2014 with a record 177 co-sponsoring nations; the first observance was held in 2015.
examFacts: Date: June 21 (longest day in Northern Hemisphere)

items.headline: Uddhav resigns; Eknath Shinde takes over as Maharashtra CM
items.detail: After a two-week rebellion led by Eknath Shinde, Uddhav Thackeray resigned as Maharashtra chief minister on June 29, 2022, hours before a floor test. Shinde was sworn in as chief minister on June 30 with Devendra Fadnavis as deputy chief minister.

items.headline: Neeraj Chopra sets national record 89.94 m in Stockholm
items.detail: Olympic champion Neeraj Chopra threw 89.94 m at the Stockholm Diamond League on June 30, 2022, setting a new Indian national record and finishing second behind Anderson Peters (90.31 m).

items.headline: PSLV-C53 flies 3 Singapore satellites; POEM platform debuts
items.detail: ISRO's PSLV-C53 launched on June 30, 2022 carrying three Singapore satellites (DS-EO, NeuSAR and SCOOB-1) from Sriharikota. Its spent fourth stage became the first actively stabilised PSLV Orbital Experiment Module (POEM) hosting six Indian payloads, including two from start-ups.
examFacts: POEM: spent PS4 stage as orbital platform

quiz.q: The Agnipath recruitment scheme was announced on:
quiz.solution: It was announced on June 14, 2022; recruits serve a four-year tenure as Agniveers.

quiz.q: Under the Agnipath scheme, what share of each Agniveer batch can be retained in permanent service?
quiz.solution: Up to 25% of each retiring batch is retained; the rest get a lump sum of about Rs 11.71 lakh.

quiz.q: India's first private train under the Bharat Gaurav scheme (June 2022) ran on which route?
quiz.solution: The Coimbatore-Shirdi service began on Southern Railway on June 14, 2022.

quiz.q: The International Day of Yoga resolution was adopted by the UN General Assembly on:
quiz.solution: The UNGA adopted it on December 11, 2014 with a record 177 co-sponsors; first observance was June 21, 2015.

quiz.q: Who was sworn in as Maharashtra chief minister on June 30, 2022?
quiz.solution: Eknath Shinde took oath as CM with Devendra Fadnavis as deputy, after Uddhav Thackeray resigned on June 29.

quiz.q: Neeraj Chopra's national-record javelin throw of 89.94 m came at the 2022 Diamond League in:
quiz.solution: He threw 89.94 m in Stockholm on June 30, 2022, finishing behind Anderson Peters.

quiz.q: PSLV-C53 (June 2022) carried three satellites belonging to which country?
quiz.solution: DS-EO, NeuSAR and SCOOB-1 were Singaporean; the spent PS4 stage debuted as the POEM platform.

quiz.q: What is POEM on PSLV flights?
options: A satellite bus for GEO missions
An orbital platform using the spent PSLV fourth stage
quiz.solution: The PSLV Orbital Experiment Module reuses the spent PS4 stage to host in-orbit experiments.

quiz.q: World Environment Day 2022 was hosted by which country with the theme 'Only One Earth'?
quiz.solution: Sweden hosted on June 5, 2022, marking 50 years since the 1972 Stockholm Conference.

quiz.q: Which rivers forced the major June 2022 flood wave in Assam?
quiz.solution: The Brahmaputra and Barak overflowed in the June-September 2022 wave, affecting 32 districts.

items.headline: India win ODI series in England 2-1
items.detail: India won the three-match ODI series in England 2-1, clinching it with a five-wicket win at Old Trafford on July 17, 2022, where Rishabh Pant hit an unbeaten 125 for his first ODI century. Earlier, Jasprit Bumrah took 6/19 in the series opener at The Oval.
examFacts: Pant: 125 not out, first ODI century

items.headline: 16th presidential election held; Murmu vs Sinha
items.detail: India's 16th presidential election was held on July 18, 2022 between NDA nominee Droupadi Murmu and united opposition nominee Yashwant Sinha, with an electoral college turnout of 99.12%; counting took place on July 21.
examFacts: Candidates: Droupadi Murmu vs Yashwant Sinha

items.headline: First-ever Chess Olympiad torch relay begins in Delhi
items.detail: The first torch relay in Chess Olympiad history was flagged off on July 19, 2022 at Delhi's Indira Gandhi Arena, travelling through 75 cities over 40 days to reach Chennai, host of the 44th Chess Olympiad.
examFacts: 75 cities over 40 days, ending in Chennai

items.headline: Ranil Wickremesinghe elected Sri Lanka President
items.detail: Sri Lanka's Parliament elected Ranil Wickremesinghe as President on July 20, 2022, a week after Gotabaya Rajapaksa resigned (July 14) amid mass protests and fled the country.

items.headline: Droupadi Murmu elected President of India
items.detail: NDA candidate Droupadi Murmu won the presidential election on July 21, 2022 with 676,803 electoral votes (64.03%) against Yashwant Sinha's 380,177. She became the first President from a Scheduled Tribe, the second woman in the office, and the first President born after independence.
examFacts: First tribal President; second woman President

items.headline: Neeraj Chopra wins silver at World Athletics Championships
items.detail: Neeraj Chopra took silver in the javelin at the World Athletics Championships in Eugene, Oregon (July 15-24, 2022) with 88.13 m, behind Grenada's Anderson Peters (90.54 m) - India's best-ever result at the championships, hosted by the US for the first time.

items.headline: Droupadi Murmu sworn in as 15th President
items.detail: Droupadi Murmu was sworn in as the 15th President of India on July 25, 2022, succeeding Ram Nath Kovind, becoming the first person from a tribal community to hold the country's highest constitutional office.

items.headline: Illicit liquor deaths in Botad district, Gujarat
items.detail: About 42 people died in Botad district, Gujarat after consuming illicit liquor in late July 2022, one of the state's worse hooch tragedies in recent years.

items.headline: Kargil Vijay Diwas observed on July 26
items.detail: Kargil Vijay Diwas is observed every year on July 26, marking the end of the 1999 Kargil War and Operation Vijay, in which the Indian Army recaptured occupied positions in the Kargil district of Ladakh; 527 Indian soldiers were killed in the war.

items.headline: Navy takes delivery of indigenous carrier INS Vikrant
items.detail: The Indian Navy received delivery of INS Vikrant from Cochin Shipyard on July 28, 2022, ahead of its commissioning on September 2 - the country's first indigenously designed and built aircraft carrier.

items.headline: 44th Chess Olympiad opens at Mamallapuram near Chennai
items.detail: The 44th Chess Olympiad was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi at Mamallapuram near Chennai (July 28-August 9, 2022). Uzbekistan won the open section; India took bronze in both the open and women's sections and won the Gaprindashvili Trophy.
examFacts: India: bronze in open and women's sections

items.headline: Cricket returns to Commonwealth Games; India women reach final
items.detail: Women's Twenty20 cricket returned to the Commonwealth Games (July 29-August 7, 2022, Birmingham) after 1998. India reached the final, beating England in the semi-final, and took silver after losing the gold medal match to Australia by 9 runs on August 7.

quiz.q: Droupadi Murmu was elected President of India in July 2022 with what share of electoral votes?
quiz.solution: She polled 676,803 votes (64.03%) against Yashwant Sinha's 380,177.

quiz.q: Droupadi Murmu is India's first President from which community?
quiz.solution: She is the first Scheduled Tribe President and the second woman President.

quiz.q: Who did Droupadi Murmu succeed as President of India on July 25, 2022?
quiz.solution: Ram Nath Kovind's term ended on July 24, 2022; Murmu took oath the next day.

quiz.q: Neeraj Chopra's silver-winning throw at the 2022 World Athletics Championships was:
quiz.solution: He threw 88.13 m at Eugene; Anderson Peters won gold with 90.54 m.

quiz.q: Where were the 2022 World Athletics Championships, the first hosted by the USA, held?
quiz.solution: The championships ran July 15-24, 2022 at Hayward Field, Eugene, Oregon.

quiz.q: The 44th Chess Olympiad (2022) was held at:
quiz.solution: It ran July 28-August 9, 2022 at Mamallapuram near Chennai, inaugurated by PM Modi.

quiz.q: Which country won the open section of the 44th Chess Olympiad?
quiz.solution: Uzbekistan went undefeated for gold; Armenia took silver and India bronze.

quiz.q: Which country did India lose to in the women's cricket gold medal match at CWG 2022?
quiz.solution: Australia beat India by 9 runs on August 7, 2022; India took silver.

quiz.q: Kargil Vijay Diwas, marking the end of the 1999 Kargil War under Operation Vijay, falls on:
quiz.solution: It is observed on July 26, the day the war officially ended in 1999.

quiz.q: Who was elected President of Sri Lanka by its Parliament on July 20, 2022?
quiz.solution: Wickremesinghe was elected a week after Gotabaya Rajapaksa's resignation on July 14.

items.headline: India win first-ever CWG medal in lawn bowls
items.detail: India's women's fours team - Rupa Rani Tirkey, Nayanmoni Saikia, Lovely Choubey and Pinki Singh - won gold in lawn bowls at the Birmingham Commonwealth Games on August 2, 2022, India's first-ever CWG medal in the sport.
examFacts: First CWG lawn bowls medal for India

items.headline: Jagdeep Dhankhar elected Vice President of India
items.detail: NDA candidate Jagdeep Dhankhar, then Governor of West Bengal, won the vice-presidential election on August 6, 2022, defeating opposition candidate Margaret Alva by 528 votes to 182 - the biggest margin since 1992. He took oath as the 14th Vice President on August 11, 2022.

items.headline: ISRO's first SSLV flight ends in failure
items.detail: ISRO's maiden flight of the Small Satellite Launch Vehicle (SSLV-D1) on August 7, 2022 failed to place its satellites - EOS-02 and the student-built AzaadiSAT - into the planned circular orbit due to a software glitch; both satellites were lost.

items.headline: Arshad Nadeem wins CWG javelin gold with Games record
items.detail: Pakistan's Arshad Nadeem won the men's javelin at the Birmingham Commonwealth Games on August 7, 2022 with a Games-record throw of 90.18 m; Grenada's Anderson Peters (88.64 m) took silver. India's Neeraj Chopra, the defending Olympic champion, did not compete due to injury.
examFacts: Neeraj Chopra missed with a groin injury

items.headline: India finish 4th at CWG 2022 with 61 medals
items.detail: India ended the Birmingham 2022 Commonwealth Games (July 28-August 8) fourth on the medal table with 61 medals, including 22 gold. P. V. Sindhu won badminton singles gold, while table tennis star Sharath Kamal was India's most successful athlete with three golds and a silver.

items.headline: Nitish Kumar quits NDA, returns as Bihar CM
items.detail: Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar resigned on August 9, 2022 after the JD(U) broke from the BJP-led NDA, and was sworn in again the next day leading a 'Mahagathbandhan' government with the RJD and Congress support - his eighth term as chief minister.

items.headline: US signs CHIPS and Science Act for semiconductor push
items.detail: US President Joe Biden signed the CHIPS and Science Act on August 9, 2022, authorising about $280 billion overall - including $39 billion in subsidies for chip manufacturing on US soil and a 25% investment tax credit - to strengthen domestic semiconductor production.

items.headline: Har Ghar Tiranga campaign under Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav
items.detail: As India marked 75 years of independence, the government ran the Har Ghar Tiranga campaign (August 13-15, 2022) under Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav, urging citizens to hoist the tricolour at home, with the Ministry of Culture coordinating the drive.
examFacts: Part of: Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav

items.headline: US signs Inflation Reduction Act, biggest climate law
items.detail: US President Joe Biden signed the Inflation Reduction Act on August 16, 2022 - the largest climate and clean-energy investment in US history, with roughly $391 billion for energy security and cutting greenhouse gas emissions, alongside healthcare and tax provisions.

items.headline: Praggnanandhaa beats Magnus Carlsen three games in a row
items.detail: India's teenage grandmaster R. Praggnanandhaa defeated world champion Magnus Carlsen in three consecutive classical games at the FTX Crypto Cup in Miami in August 2022, a rare feat against the Norwegian.

items.headline: Pakistan declares emergency as floods devastate country
items.detail: Pakistan declared a national emergency on August 25, 2022 amid monsoon floods that eventually killed about 1,700 people and affected roughly 33 million, with damage estimated in the tens of billions of dollars.

items.headline: Justice U. U. Lalit sworn in as 49th Chief Justice of India
items.detail: Justice U. U. Lalit took oath as the 49th Chief Justice of India on August 27, 2022, a day after Justice N. V. Ramana retired. His tenure ran until November 8, 2022.

items.headline: Noida Supertech twin towers brought down by implosion
items.detail: The illegally built Supertech twin towers Apex (about 103 m) and Ceyane (about 97 m) at Sector 93A, Noida were demolished by controlled implosion on August 28, 2022 using over 3,700 kg of explosives - India's largest building demolition.
examFacts: Towers: Apex and Ceyane, Emerald Court

quiz.q: Who was sworn in as the 14th Vice President of India on August 11, 2022?
quiz.solution: Jagdeep Dhankhar won the August 6, 2022 election 528-182 and took oath on August 11.

quiz.q: In the 2022 vice-presidential election, Jagdeep Dhankhar defeated:
quiz.solution: The united opposition candidate Margaret Alva polled 182 votes against Dhankhar's 528.

quiz.q: ISRO's first Small Satellite Launch Vehicle flight, SSLV-D1 (August 7, 2022), failed due to:
quiz.solution: A software glitch shifted guidance to open-loop mode, leaving satellites in an unusable elliptical orbit.

quiz.q: How many medals did India win at the Birmingham 2022 Commonwealth Games?
quiz.solution: India finished fourth with 61 medals, including 22 gold.

quiz.q: Who won the men's javelin gold at CWG 2022 with a Games-record 90.18 m?
quiz.solution: Pakistan's Arshad Nadeem threw 90.18 m on August 7, 2022; Neeraj Chopra skipped the event injured.

quiz.q: India's first-ever Commonwealth Games medal in lawn bowls (gold, 2022) came in the:
quiz.solution: The women's fours team won gold on August 2, 2022 at Birmingham.

quiz.q: After breaking with the BJP-led NDA in August 2022, Nitish Kumar formed the government in Bihar with:
quiz.solution: He resigned on August 9 and was re-sworn on August 10 with RJD and Congress support.

quiz.q: The Supertech twin towers demolished in Noida on August 28, 2022 were named:
quiz.solution: Apex and Ceyane of the Emerald Court complex were brought down with 3,700+ kg of explosives.

quiz.q: The Har Ghar Tiranga campaign of August 2022 was run under:
quiz.solution: It ran August 13-15, 2022 under Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav marking 75 years of independence.

quiz.q: The CHIPS and Science Act signed by Joe Biden in August 2022 targets which industry?
quiz.solution: It provides $39 billion in subsidies plus tax credits to build up US chip manufacturing.

items.headline: India's GDP grows 13.5% in Q1 of FY2022-23
items.detail: India's economy grew 13.5% year-on-year in the April-June 2022 quarter (Q1 of FY2022-23), the fastest pace in about a year, driven by a low base from the 2021 lockdown quarter.

items.headline: INS Vikrant, first made-in-India aircraft carrier, commissioned
items.detail: Prime Minister Narendra Modi commissioned INS Vikrant at Cochin Shipyard, Kochi on September 2, 2022. Built at a cost of about Rs 20,000 crore, the roughly 45,000-tonne carrier is India's first indigenously designed and built aircraft carrier and the country's largest warship.

items.headline: Cyrus Mistry dies in road accident
items.detail: Cyrus Mistry, former chairman of Tata Sons, died in a car crash on the Ahmedabad-Mumbai highway in Palghar district, Maharashtra on September 4, 2022. He was the sixth chairman of the Tata Group, serving from 2012 until his removal in 2016.
examFacts: Sixth chairman of the Tata Group

items.headline: Queen Elizabeth II dies; Charles III becomes King
items.detail: Queen Elizabeth II, Britain's longest-reigning monarch, died at Balmoral Castle in Scotland on September 8, 2022, aged 96. Her eldest son became King Charles III, and her state funeral was held at Westminster Abbey on September 19, 2022.

items.headline: Neeraj Chopra wins Diamond League final in Zurich
items.detail: Olympic champion Neeraj Chopra won the javelin title at the 2022 Diamond League final (Weltklasse Zurich) on September 8, 2022 with a best throw of 88.44 m, becoming the first Indian ever to win a Diamond League trophy.
examFacts: First Indian to win the Diamond League

items.headline: Bajrang, Vinesh take bronze at World Wrestling Championships
items.detail: At the 2022 World Wrestling Championships in Belgrade, Serbia (September 10-18), Bajrang Punia won bronze in men's freestyle 65 kg and Vinesh Phogat won bronze in women's 53 kg.

items.headline: Sri Lanka win Asia Cup 2022
items.detail: Sri Lanka beat Pakistan by 23 runs in the final at Dubai on September 11, 2022 to win the 2022 Asia Cup, a T20-format edition held in the UAE. It was Sri Lanka's sixth Asia Cup title and first in the T20I format.

items.headline: Project Cheetah: eight cheetahs from Namibia reach Kuno
items.detail: On September 17, 2022, eight cheetahs - five females and three males - were flown in from Namibia and released in quarantine enclosures at Kuno National Park, Madhya Pradesh, under Project Cheetah, India's first attempt to reintroduce the cheetah.
examFacts: Site: Kuno National Park, Madhya Pradesh

items.headline: Russia orders partial mobilization of reservists
items.detail: In a televised address on September 21, 2022, Russian President Vladimir Putin announced a partial mobilization of reservists for what Russia calls its special military operation in Ukraine, with Defence Minister Sergei Shoigu stating a target of 300,000 reservists.

items.headline: R. Venkataramani appointed Attorney-General of India
items.detail: The President appointed senior advocate R. Venkataramani as the Attorney-General for India in September 2022; he succeeded K. K. Venugopal as the government's chief law officer.

items.headline: Popular Front of India banned for five years
items.detail: On September 28, 2022, the Ministry of Home Affairs banned the Popular Front of India (PFI) and eight affiliated organisations for five years under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, declaring them unlawful associations.

items.headline: General Anil Chauhan appointed Chief of Defence Staff
items.detail: General Anil Chauhan (retired) was appointed India's second Chief of Defence Staff on September 28, 2022 and took charge on September 30. He succeeded General Bipin Rawat, who died in a helicopter crash in December 2021.

items.headline: Supreme Court: all women can seek abortion till 24 weeks
items.detail: On September 29, 2022, a Supreme Court bench led by Justice D. Y. Chandrachud held that all women, married or unmarried, are entitled to seek a safe legal abortion up to 24 weeks of pregnancy under the Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act.
examFacts: Ruling: unmarried women equal right up to 24 weeks
Bench led by: Justice D. Y. Chandrachud

quiz.q: INS Vikrant, India's first indigenously built aircraft carrier, was commissioned on:
quiz.solution: PM Modi commissioned INS Vikrant at Cochin Shipyard, Kochi on September 2, 2022.

quiz.q: Which shipyard built India's first indigenous aircraft carrier INS Vikrant?
quiz.solution: INS Vikrant was designed and built by Cochin Shipyard Limited and commissioned at Kochi.

quiz.q: Who was appointed India's second Chief of Defence Staff in September 2022?
quiz.solution: Retired General Anil Chauhan was appointed CDS on September 28, 2022, succeeding Bipin Rawat.

quiz.q: Under Project Cheetah (September 2022), eight cheetahs were released at Kuno National Park in:
quiz.solution: The eight cheetahs flown in from Namibia were released at Kuno National Park, Madhya Pradesh, on September 17, 2022.

quiz.q: Which country won the 2022 Asia Cup cricket tournament held in the UAE?
quiz.solution: Sri Lanka beat Pakistan by 23 runs in the Dubai final on September 11, 2022 for a sixth Asia Cup title.

quiz.q: Neeraj Chopra's winning throw in the 2022 Diamond League final at Zurich was:
quiz.solution: He won the September 8, 2022 final with 88.44 m, becoming the first Indian Diamond League champion.

quiz.q: Who died in a road accident on September 4, 2022, six years after being removed as Tata Sons chairman?
quiz.solution: Cyrus Mistry, the Tata Group's sixth chairman (2012-2016), died in a crash in Palghar, Maharashtra.

quiz.q: The 2022 Nobel-year month in which Queen Elizabeth II died and King Charles III succeeded her is:
quiz.solution: Elizabeth II died on September 8, 2022 at Balmoral; her state funeral was on September 19, 2022.

quiz.q: India's GDP in the April-June 2022 quarter (Q1 FY23) grew at what year-on-year rate?
quiz.solution: Official estimates put Q1 FY2022-23 GDP growth at 13.5% year-on-year.

quiz.q: In September 2022 the Supreme Court ruled that the right to terminate a pregnancy up to 24 weeks extends to:
quiz.solution: The September 29, 2022 judgment made unmarried women equally entitled under the MTP Act.

items.headline: T20 World Cup begins in Australia; Kohli stars
items.detail: The ICC Men's T20 World Cup ran in Australia from October 16 to November 13, 2022. Virat Kohli played an unbeaten 82 against Pakistan at the Melbourne Cricket Ground and finished the tournament as its highest run-scorer with 296 runs.

items.headline: 5G telecom services launched in 13 cities
items.detail: India's 5G telecom services went live on October 1, 2022, starting in 13 selected cities ahead of a nationwide rollout.

items.headline: Nobel Medicine to Svante Paabo for ancient genomes
items.detail: The 2022 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine went to Sweden's Svante Paabo for his discoveries on the genomes of extinct hominins and human evolution.

items.headline: Nobel Physics for entangled-photon experiments
items.detail: Alain Aspect (France), John Clauser (US) and Anton Zeilinger (Austria) shared the 2022 Nobel Prize in Physics for experiments with entangled photons that established the violation of Bell inequalities and pioneered quantum information science.

items.headline: Nobel Chemistry for click chemistry
items.detail: Carolyn Bertozzi (US), Morten Meldal (Denmark) and Barry Sharpless (US) won the 2022 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing click chemistry and bioorthogonal chemistry. It was Sharpless's second Nobel.

items.headline: Annie Ernaux wins the Nobel Literature
items.detail: French writer Annie Ernaux won the 2022 Nobel Prize in Literature, cited for the courage and clinical acuity with which she explores personal memory and collective restraints.

items.headline: Nobel Peace for human-rights champions
items.detail: The 2022 Nobel Peace Prize went to Ales Bialiatski of Belarus, the Russian organisation Memorial and Ukraine's Centre for Civil Liberties for their civil-society efforts defending citizen rights and documenting abuses of power.
examFacts: Laureates: Bialiatski, Memorial, Centre for Civil Liberties

items.headline: Nobel Economics for bank-and-crisis research
items.detail: Ben Bernanke, Douglas Diamond and Philip Dybvig (all US) won the 2022 Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences for research on banks and financial crises.

items.headline: CJI Lalit names Justice Chandrachud his successor
items.detail: Chief Justice U. U. Lalit recommended Justice D. Y. Chandrachud as his successor before retiring on November 8, 2022 - setting up the 50th CJI.

items.headline: Mallikarjun Kharge elected Congress president
items.detail: Mallikarjun Kharge defeated Shashi Tharoor to become Congress president on October 19, 2022 - the party's first non-Gandhi president in 24 years.

items.headline: ISRO's LVM3 flies its first commercial mission
items.detail: On October 22, 2022 ISRO's LVM3 rocket flew its first commercial mission, LVM3-M2, injecting 36 OneWeb satellites into low Earth orbit from Sriharikota.

items.headline: Rishi Sunak becomes UK Prime Minister
items.detail: Rishi Sunak took office as Britain's Prime Minister on October 25, 2022, appointed by King Charles III - the first British Asian to hold the office and, at 42, the youngest PM since 1812. He succeeded Liz Truss, who had announced her resignation on October 20.

items.headline: BCCI announces equal match fees for men and women
items.detail: On October 27, 2022 the BCCI announced equal match fees for India's men and women cricketers across all three formats.

items.headline: Morbi suspension bridge collapses in Gujarat
items.detail: The colonial-era 'Jhulto Pul' suspension bridge over the Machchhu river at Morbi, Gujarat collapsed on the evening of October 30, 2022, killing at least 141 people. It had reopened just five days earlier after renovation.

items.headline: National Unity Day observed on October 31
items.detail: Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (National Unity Day) was observed on October 31, marking Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's birth anniversary. Observed since 2014, it honours Patel's role in India's political integration.

quiz.q: India's 5G telecom services were launched on October 1, 2022 in how many cities?
quiz.solution: 5G services went live on October 1, 2022, starting in 13 selected cities.

quiz.q: Who won the 2022 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine?
quiz.solution: Svante Paabo won for his discoveries on the genomes of extinct hominins and human evolution.

quiz.q: The 2022 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded for developing:
quiz.solution: Bertozzi, Meldal and Sharpless won for click chemistry and bioorthogonal chemistry.

quiz.q: At 42, the youngest British Prime Minister since 1812, appointed in October 2022, is:
quiz.solution: Rishi Sunak took office on October 25, 2022 - the first British Asian PM and the youngest since 1812.

quiz.q: ISRO's first commercial LVM3 mission, LVM3-M2 of October 2022, carried how many satellites?
quiz.solution: LVM3-M2 launched 36 OneWeb satellites into low Earth orbit on October 22, 2022.

quiz.q: The Morbi bridge that collapsed on October 30, 2022 spanned which river?
quiz.solution: The 'Jhulto Pul' stood over the Machchhu river at Morbi, Gujarat; at least 141 people died.

quiz.q: Who became Congress president in October 2022 - the first non-Gandhi in 24 years?
quiz.solution: Kharge defeated Shashi Tharoor in the October 19, 2022 election.

quiz.q: In October 2022 the BCCI announced equal match fees for:
quiz.solution: The announcement of October 27, 2022 made match fees equal for men and women across all formats.

quiz.q: National Unity Day (Rashtriya Ekta Diwas), observed since 2014, falls on:
quiz.solution: It is observed on October 31, the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.

quiz.q: The 2022 ICC Men's T20 World Cup was hosted by:
quiz.solution: The tournament ran October 16 - November 13, 2022 across Australian cities; Kohli was its highest run-scorer (296).

items.headline: COP27 agrees loss and damage fund
items.detail: The UN climate conference COP27 ran November 6-20, 2022 at Sharm El-Sheikh, Egypt with about 35,000 delegates. In a first, countries agreed to set up a loss and damage fund to help nations worst hit by climate disasters.
examFacts: First-ever loss and damage fund agreed

items.headline: Justice Chandrachud sworn in as 50th CJI
items.detail: Justice Dhananjaya Y. Chandrachud was sworn in as the 50th Chief Justice of India on November 9, 2022, a day after Justice U. U. Lalit retired. His term ran until November 10, 2024.

items.headline: Russia pulls out of Kherson city
items.detail: Russian forces completed their withdrawal from Kherson city in early November 2022, and Ukrainian troops entered on November 11. Kherson was the only regional capital Russia had captured in the 2022 invasion.
examFacts: Only regional capital Russia had taken

items.headline: Crypto exchange FTX files for bankruptcy
items.detail: FTX, one of the world's largest crypto exchanges, filed for bankruptcy in the US on November 11, 2022 after a run on deposits. Founder Sam Bankman-Fried was arrested in the Bahamas on December 12, 2022.

items.headline: England win T20 World Cup at the MCG
items.detail: England beat Pakistan by five wickets in the T20 World Cup final at the Melbourne Cricket Ground on November 13, 2022 for their second T20 title. Sam Curran was named both Player of the Match and Player of the Tournament.

items.headline: World population reaches 8 billion
items.detail: The United Nations marked November 15, 2022 as the approximate day the world population crossed 8 billion, crediting better health and falling mortality. UN projections see growth peaking at around 10.4 billion in the 2080s.
examFacts: Projected peak: about 10.4 billion in the 2080s

items.headline: G20 summit held in Bali
items.detail: The 17th G20 summit met at Nusa Dua, Bali on November 15-16, 2022 under Indonesia's chairmanship with the motto 'Recover Together, Recover Stronger'. The closing declaration noted most members condemned Russia's invasion of Ukraine, and India's presidency began on December 1, 2022.
examFacts: India took over the presidency from December 1, 2022

items.headline: NASA launches Artemis 1 to the Moon
items.detail: NASA launched Artemis 1 on November 16, 2022 from Kennedy Space Center - the first flight of the Space Launch System rocket carrying the Orion capsule on an uncrewed test flight around the Moon, ahead of future crewed missions.
examFacts: Rocket: Space Launch System; craft: Orion

items.headline: Skyroot launches India's first private rocket
items.detail: Hyderabad-based startup Skyroot Aerospace launched Vikram-S, India's first privately built rocket, from Sriharikota on November 18, 2022 under the mission 'Prarambh'. The single-stage solid-fuel rocket reached about 89.5 km altitude.
examFacts: Vikram-S: first Indian privately built rocket

items.headline: Kashi Tamil Sangamam opens at Varanasi
items.detail: PM Modi inaugurated the month-long Kashi Tamil Sangamam at Varanasi on November 19, 2022, an education ministry cultural exchange celebrating centuries-old links between Tamil Nadu and Kashi under Ek Bharat Shrestha Bharat.

items.headline: General Asim Munir named Pakistan Army chief
items.detail: Pakistan appointed General Asim Munir as Chief of Army Staff on November 24, 2022; he took charge on November 29, succeeding Qamar Javed Bajwa.

items.headline: Constitution Day observed on November 26
items.detail: Constitution Day (Samvidhan Divas) was observed on November 26, marking the Constituent Assembly's adoption of the Constitution in 1949. It has been observed annually since 2015.

quiz.q: Who became the 50th Chief Justice of India in November 2022?
quiz.solution: Justice D. Y. Chandrachud was sworn in on November 9, 2022 after U. U. Lalit retired.

quiz.q: Which team won the 2022 ICC Men's T20 World Cup?
quiz.solution: England beat Pakistan by five wickets at the MCG on November 13, 2022.

quiz.q: Who was named Player of the Match in the 2022 T20 World Cup final?
quiz.solution: England's Sam Curran was both Player of the Match and Player of the Tournament.

quiz.q: The UN marked which date as the day world population crossed 8 billion?
quiz.solution: The Day of Eight Billion was November 15, 2022.

quiz.q: Vikram-S, India's first privately built rocket, was made by which startup?
quiz.solution: Skyroot launched Vikram-S from Sriharikota on November 18, 2022 under mission Prarambh.

quiz.q: COP27 in November 2022 was hosted by which city?
quiz.solution: COP27 ran November 6-20, 2022 at Sharm El-Sheikh, Egypt.

quiz.q: The landmark climate-finance outcome of COP27 was a fund for:
quiz.solution: COP27 agreed, for the first time, to a loss and damage fund for vulnerable countries.

quiz.q: The 2022 G20 summit was held at:
quiz.solution: The 17th G20 summit met at Nusa Dua, Bali on November 15-16, 2022.

quiz.q: Who was appointed Pakistan's Army Chief in November 2022?
quiz.solution: General Asim Munir was named COAS on November 24, 2022 and took charge five days later.

quiz.q: Constitution Day of India, observed since 2015, falls on:
quiz.solution: It marks the Constituent Assembly's adoption of the Constitution on November 26, 1949.

items.headline: India takes charge of G20 presidency
items.detail: India assumed the G20 presidency on December 1, 2022, holding it until November 30, 2023, after taking over from Indonesia at the Bali summit. The theme was 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam - One Earth, One Family, One Future', and the 18th G20 Leaders' Summit was set for New Delhi in September 2023.
examFacts: Theme: One Earth, One Family, One Future

items.headline: AAP sweeps Delhi MCD elections
items.detail: Voting for the unified 250-member Municipal Corporation of Delhi was held on December 4, 2022, with results on December 7. The Aam Aadmi Party won 134 seats to end the BJP's long control of Delhi's civic body; the BJP got 104 and Congress 9.

items.headline: G7 caps Russian seaborne oil at $60
items.detail: The G7, EU and Australia put a US$60-per-barrel price cap on Russian seaborne crude from December 5, 2022. Western shippers and insurers could serve Russian oil cargoes only if they were priced at or below the cap.

items.headline: Mirabai Chanu takes Worlds silver in Bogota
items.detail: At the 2022 World Weightlifting Championships in Bogota, Colombia (December 5-16), India's Mirabai Chanu won silver in the women's 49 kg with a 200 kg total. China topped the medal table.

items.headline: RBI raises repo rate to 6.25 percent
items.detail: The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee on December 7, 2022 raised the repo rate by 35 basis points to 6.25 percent - the fifth straight increase, taking cumulative tightening to 225 basis points since May 2022. It was the smallest hike of that cycle.

items.headline: China scraps zero-COVID policy
items.detail: On December 7, 2022, China announced a sweeping loosening of its strict zero-COVID rules - dropping compulsory PCR tests and quarantine - after nationwide protests and heavy economic costs. It was the last major economy to abandon the approach.

items.headline: Peru President Castillo ousted after self-coup bid
items.detail: On December 7, 2022, Peru's President Pedro Castillo announced the dissolution of Congress in a self-coup attempt; Congress impeached and removed him the same day by 101 votes to 6. Vice President Dina Boluarte was sworn in as president and Castillo was arrested.

items.headline: BJP wins record 156 seats in Gujarat
items.detail: Results on December 8, 2022 gave the BJP 156 of Gujarat's 182 seats with 52.5% votes - the best tally any party has ever won in the state. Congress collapsed to 17 seats, while the Aam Aadmi Party opened its account with 5. Bhupendra Patel continued as Chief Minister.

items.headline: Congress ousts BJP in Himachal Pradesh
items.detail: The December 8, 2022 results for Himachal Pradesh's 68-seat assembly gave the Congress 40 seats against the BJP's 25, continuing the hill state's trend of voting out incumbent governments since 1985. Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu became Chief Minister, with Mukesh Agnihotri as Deputy CM.

items.headline: NASA's Artemis 1 returns Orion safely
items.detail: NASA's Artemis 1 uncrewed Moon mission ended on December 11, 2022 when the Orion capsule splashed down in the Pacific after a 25-day flight. It was the first integrated flight of the Space Launch System rocket and Orion, and Orion set a record for the farthest distance travelled by a human-rated spacecraft (over 432,000 km).

items.headline: Argentina beat France for FIFA World Cup
items.detail: Argentina won their third FIFA World Cup on December 18, 2022, beating holders France 4-2 on penalties after a 3-3 extra-time thriller at Lusail Stadium, Qatar. Lionel Messi won the Golden Ball as player of the tournament; Kylian Mbappe took the Golden Boot with 8 goals including a final hat-trick.
examFacts: Golden Ball: Messi; Golden Boot: Mbappe (8)

items.headline: Zelenskyy addresses US Congress
items.detail: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy addressed a joint session of the US Congress on December 21, 2022 - his first trip outside Ukraine since Russia's full-scale invasion began - pressing for continued American military and financial aid.

items.headline: National Mathematics Day observed
items.detail: National Mathematics Day was observed on December 22, marking the birth anniversary of mathematician Srinivasa Ramanujan. The day was declared in 2011 to honour Ramanujan on his 125th birth anniversary.

items.headline: Sam Curran becomes IPL's costliest buy
items.detail: At the IPL 2023 mini-auction in Kochi on December 23, 2022, England all-rounder Sam Curran became the most expensive player in IPL history when Punjab Kings bought him for Rs 18.5 crore.
examFacts: Sam Curran: Rs 18.5 crore, Punjab Kings

items.headline: Netanyahu sworn in to lead Israel again
items.detail: Benjamin Netanyahu was sworn in as Israel's Prime Minister on December 29, 2022, heading the country's 37th government after his Likud-led bloc won the November 2022 Knesset election.

items.headline: Football legend Pele dies at 82
items.detail: Brazilian great Pele, the only player to win three FIFA World Cups (1958, 1962, 1970), died in Sao Paulo on December 29, 2022 at the age of 82.

items.headline: Pope Emeritus Benedict XVI dies at 95
items.detail: Pope Benedict XVI, born Joseph Ratzinger, died on December 31, 2022 at 95. He led the Catholic Church from 2005 to 2013 and became the first pope in nearly 600 years to resign when he stepped down citing health reasons.

quiz.q: Which country won the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar?
quiz.solution: Argentina beat France 4-2 on penalties after a 3-3 final at Lusail on December 18, 2022.

quiz.q: Who won the Golden Ball as best player of the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
quiz.solution: Messi won his second Golden Ball; Mbappe took the Golden Boot with 8 goals.

quiz.q: What was India's G20 presidency theme for 2022-23?
quiz.solution: The theme was 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam - One Earth, One Family, One Future'.

quiz.q: By how much did the RBI raise the repo rate at its December 2022 policy review?
quiz.solution: The December 7, 2022 hike of 35 bps took the repo rate to 6.25%.

quiz.q: What repo rate level did the RBI set at its December 2022 policy?
quiz.solution: After the fifth straight hike, the repo rate stood at 6.25% in December 2022.

quiz.q: How many seats did the BJP win in the December 2022 Gujarat assembly election?
quiz.solution: BJP's 156 of 182 seats was the best tally any party has won in Gujarat.

quiz.q: Who became Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh after the December 2022 results?
quiz.solution: Congress won 40 of 68 seats and chose Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu as CM.

quiz.q: Which party won majority in the December 2022 Delhi MCD election?
quiz.solution: AAP won 134 of 250 wards, ending BJP's run atop Delhi's civic body.

quiz.q: Pele, who died in December 2022, won how many FIFA World Cups?
quiz.solution: He is the only player with three World Cup wins: 1958, 1962 and 1970.

quiz.q: Benedict XVI's 2013 resignation was the first papal resignation since which year?
quiz.solution: He was the first pope to resign since Gregory XII in 1415.
